cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Strategic Retreat
cards.instruction: Describe every loss of control as a deliberate concession made from strength.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've released the gallery from hosting my exhibition. They need time to develop their standards.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They rejected us. Shall I collect your paintings?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. I'm withdrawing the work to give them that time. Use the padded sleeves, please; we still collect professionally.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They've already put it outside. I'll bring the van.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. I'm yielding the frontage as well. Bring the van right up to the paintings; please don't leave them enjoying my display for another minute.
